visible.presentation_text:
Consult request from an experienced volunteer at the facility; the volunteer is not a licensed rehabilitator.

Adult red fox, found in a field, ataxic with intermittent tremor, responsive to environment, no aggression, no hypersalivation. Presentation is consistent with several etiologies — anticoagulant or neurotoxic rodenticide exposure, sarcoptic mange with secondary debilitation, canine distemper, or head trauma — which carry very different prognoses and treatments. Bloodwork and a toxicology screen can be run this afternoon. Animal is stable in a quiet holding kennel.
